name: -6 AN to -6 AN Fitting Male to Male Flare Union
title: -6 AN to -6 AN Fitting Male to Male Flare Union
description:
The -6 AN to -6 AN Fitting Male to Male Flare Union is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings AN Male to Male Flare Unions are precision CNC-machined to connect two female AN fittings while maintaining a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal. Designed for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems, these unions provide a reliable straight-through connection for custom plumbing and high-performance fluid transfer applications.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
